scope: Existing Binder extended with three observed typed connections; no new canonical system, Family, graph relation or research activation.

on_mount: Select existing cubic Ihara source and Visual1 follow
activation.user_override: Source-owned follow controls remain available. Manual Player-bit capture stops Pascal follow. Explicit reconnect re-enables the three declared contracts.
activation.missing_source: HOLD, not a local synthetic fallback or a stale live record

observations.m3_stack: Validate shared M3 trace fingerprint, sample cursor, Stack readback and plate-local visibility. Show actual M3 and Stack timer flags separately.
observations.player_pascal: Accept only current validated Player receipts from this Bench instance. Live import retains receipt sequence and full coordinate witness; Pascal return scope is four bits only. Open layer may supply bits but remains explicitly open.
observations.held_vs_live: Held input is labelled HELD and does not follow later packets. Missing Player source clears the LIVE record. Last held data can be displayed only as held.
observations.ihara: Compare cubic source index/revision/channel to Visual1 readback. Show manual edge, commit/BLOCK and TESA view. C5 selection remains SEPARATE, not implicitly coerced.
observations.export: Existing four-system Binder export adds observedConnections without changing the four systems or their legacy session controls.

update_policy.mechanism: Source-owned subscribe callbacks, plus the existing Player monitor render/read watchdog
update_policy.embedded_monitor: Moves the same overview element into the existing embedded monitor; no duplicate dashboard IDs or second model. A standalone unbound Bench does not read other Club windows.

verification.integration: Actual M3, Stack, token-bound receiver, Pascal bridge, cubic graph, Visual1 and System Binder controllers in simulated DOM; 64 Player coordinates including open layer; live/held/HOLD recovery, event updates, source switching and embedded relocation.
verification.no_start_evidence: Mount/reconnect does not add intervals or timeouts, send receiver requests or advance graph revision. Tests trap unrequested Master/PENT commands.

historical_boundary: Earlier r7/r8 returns and the old M3 package hashes remain version-specific records, not current implementation pins. The known legacy M3/Mathfield pin conflicts are not repaired by this return; no global historical-suite PASS is claimed.
